{{Top|leg}}
'''Coryndr''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Coryndr commented on the entry for the [[DataSearch Engine 12C-A]], warning not to hook the unit up to a [[power condenser]] and [[power-flux regulator]]. Doing so could cause an explosion and fire.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
